summary: @servicetitan/notifications preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime binary (bun-v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, unzips it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses that freshly-downloaded alternate runtime to execute a sibling file math_init.js via execFileSync. math_init.js is a ~727KB heavily obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, shuffled string/opcode array via a WV8StW rotator, hex-named globals, integer-indexed lookups) that is unrelated to the package's stated purpose (a React notifications library). The obfuscated payload runs under Bun rather than Node, bypassing Node-based inspection, and its contents cannot be inspected transparently. The math_init.js filename is misdirection on a notifications package. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: install-time execution of an opaque payload delivered under a second runtime pulled in specifically to run it.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
